identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Young soft oval tapering to a modest rounded chin, warm light olive/golden-tan skin and fine cheek/nose speckles. Amber-hazel eyes are open almonds with rounded lower centers, not low horizontal slits. Nose has a fine relatively long central ridge, modest convexity at most and a low rounded tip. Compact mouth with shallow restrained upper line and modest rounded lower lip. Near-black smooth center-parted hair sweeps flat into a hidden low gathering.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Current and SE8c share a fine compact straighter nose, softly full bowed mouth and similarly tapered oval. The original description overstates heavy low horizontal eye apertures and pronounced nasal convexity relative to the visible native source; neither should be amplified.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Keep a relatively long fine central nasal span with a low rounded tip and only modest source-supported ridge convexity; avoid a short raised button or an exaggerated hook. Retain a compact mouth with a shallow almost-level upper bow, restrained upper-lip volume and modest rounded lower lip rather than a broad plump peaked bow. Preserve a gradual modest lower-jaw taper into a small rounded chin of limited breadth, without elongating to a pointed model chin. Remove the purple gold sun/star-like hanging with border and fringe at the upper viewer-right, including its complete cloth, emblem, border, fringe and visible attachment. Continue the adjacent plain stone architecture naturally while preserving the doorway, columns, existing framing and the entire subject; retain garment embroidery and the loose shoulder wrap. The full portrait background must contain no banners or heraldic wall hangings.
